coordinatorExecution.coverage: Actual mounted complete baseline/candidate DOM and SVG trees; stable numeric updates retain every element/text node and perform zero innerHTML writes; migrated dynamic tooltip values; real panel D and F event boundaries; missing/recovery, hidden, history, source replacement and disposal.
coordinatorExecution.limitation: Controlled bridge/scheduler/qualification fixture. This does not certify downstream application mutation wiring, production scheduling races, or hardware callback/frame budgets.

reviewFindings.finding: Panel transformations preserve authored labels, styles, precision, scalar expressions and complete SVG path accumulation order. Dynamic path values are bound only after calculation, avoiding nested markers. Static Card D output and its editable controls remain byte-identical.

WeakMap state holds one template and current bindings per card. Stable templates update unequal text or attributes; structural, empty, sparse and unavailable transitions go through one owner. Tooltip migration updates data-ui-tooltip without recreating native title. The private contract requires sole-owner HTML/SVG readout trees and nonempty plain scalar/path slot values; arbitrary external subtree edits are outside it.

Independent guarded source-section comparisons confirm acquisition order, strides, count-driven reductions, 2 Hz schedule, hub publication, qualification, inclusive history restriction, physical-time quadrature, reset and disposal remain unchanged. Only the three unavailable A/B/C call names are normalized for the update comparison.

The full-module Node fixtures check complete markup and scientific outputs; actual helper tests check slot parsing/update and namespaced attributes. These Node tests alone do not test DOM parsing. The separately executed and read coordinator browser log closes the declared actual DOM/compiler fixture gate for this revision.

openGates.detail: No inclusive callback/frame hardware matrix has run for this candidate. Stable updates avoid parse/traversal but still produce formatted strings, arrays and complete paths; structural transitions incur an extra inert parse. No speedup or foreground 60 FPS approval follows from this review.

Root must integrate and freeze the accepted candidate, preserve real app owner/mutation qualification contracts, and run the registered lifecycle/performance matrix. The isolated event fixture does not prove all application mutation races.
No common sampler/aggregate clock is fabricated or newly certified. Existing clock provenance and proxy-observation limitations remain outside T1 and unresolved.

Latency/proper-time/phase displays and their imported reference curves are unchanged reference-model observations. Renderer parity is not a recovery of causal gravity, proper-time geometry or a continuum limit.

disposition: Accept the bounded private Time readout implementation for coordinator integration. Keep source identity and independent evidence attached; release/performance and physical recovery remain unapproved.
